title: Define and establish service delivery strategy
goal: The venture knows which IT services it has to keep running, what each one promises, how and where each is run, and which of them it runs itself rather than buys.

steps.do: Read the venture's goals and telos measures and write, for each one, what has to keep running for it to be met, so the service list comes from the venture's ends and not from the tools it happens to have.
List the IT services the venture actually delivers to itself and its customers, naming for each one who uses it, what it promises in plain words, what it costs to run and what stops without it.
For each service, write how it is actually delivered: which system runs it, who or which agent role operates it, what is automated, what is still done by hand, and how a person knows it is working.
Write where each service runs and where its data sits, by region and provider, and name any service whose location the venture's own commitments or a customer's contract would not allow.

For each service, write whether the venture runs it itself, buys it or has someone else operate it, with the cost and the way out of each, and bring to the founder every change that would cost money or hand an outside party access.
Add the service list and its sourcing answers as evidence to the decision each one bears on, and raise to the product lead which service to make reliable or to stop running first.

done_criteria.check: Does every service on the list trace to a goal or a measure it keeps alive, name who operates it and where it runs, and carry one answer of run, buy or have operated?
